name: Dranik Catacombs: Chambers
summary: The central chambers of the Dranik Catacombs, used by Muramite inquisitors for experimentation and interrogation.
description: The Chambers form the central heart of the Dranik Catacombs. Once sacred Dragorn burial vaults, they were seized by Muramite inquisitors and converted into torture halls, ritual chambers, and Discord‑warped laboratories. The walls pulse with arcane corruption, and the air is thick with the echoes of suffering. Muramite officers oversee experiments on captured Dragorn, while Discord manifestations roam freely through unstable corridors.
